rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=120, tv_lr=0.013, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-7 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE = iter-4 BEST family (clip 0.08, lambda 0.001) but at the BUDGET-PROVEN tv_iterations=120 (iter-4 at 160 measured 1227.4s, OVER the 1200s HARD wall; only 120 is reproducible under budget). ONE KNOB: tv_lr 0.01->0.013 (fine grid; all else IDENTICAL to the 120-iter BEST iter-2: tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=120, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay/init/optimizer INERT). SOLVER FACT (read from tv_reconstruction): the ONLY four live knobs are tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max; GD step schedule is step=lr/(1+0.01*it) with decay hard-coded. LEVER MAP (all four live knobs): clip exhausted at top of bound [0.03,0.08] (iter-2); lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 -- up@0.003 regressed (iter-3, 0.1366), down@0.0005 regressed (iter-6, 0.1582); iters-UP@160 lowered RMSE 7.857e-4->7.825e-4 (CONVERGENCE helps) for hr 0.205->0.2085 BUT breached the wall (iter-4, 1227s); lr-UP@0.02 (2x) OVERSHOT (iter-5, 0.1873, RMSE up to 8.036e-4). KEY EVIDENCE: iter-4 proves the data term is mildly UNDER-converged at 120 iters (more steps -> lower RMSE -> higher hr), but buying that convergence via iters breaches budget AND via a 2x lr step overshoots. The UNTRIED lever is the FINE lr grid between the proven-good 0.01 and the overshooting 0.02. HYPOTHESIS: a modest +30 pct step (0.01->0.013), well below iter-5 2x overshoot, counteracts the step-decay enough to converge the data term further within the budget-safe 120 steps -- reaching iter-4-like lower residual (RMSE below 7.857e-4) WITHOUT GD overshoot, so hr rises above iter-4 BEST 0.208547 at ZERO extra compute. PREDICTED iter-7 hr ~0.210. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.208547 (no gain or regression) then EITHER (a) if hr drops, 0.013 already overshoots and the lr step-size lever is exhausted on BOTH sides of 0.01 (overshoot above, no benefit below since lr-down only slows convergence which iter-4 showed hurts), OR (b) if hr is merely flat, 120-iter convergence at lr~0.01 is already at the TV regularization ceiling and iter-4 +0.003 was within noise -- ~0.21 hr / ~0.924 SSIM is the STRUCTURAL classical-TV ceiling on real Mayo LDCT and ALL FOUR live levers (clip, lambda both ways, iters, lr both ways) are exhausted; STOP convergence-knob tuning. BUDGET: tv_lr is a ZERO marginal-compute knob at the budget-proven tv_iterations=120 -> cost model 31.8+120*7.47=928s (77 pct of 1200s, ~272s margin; +10 pct GPU-contention variance ~1018s, still under the wall). DELIBERATELY keeps tv_iterations=120 (NOT iter-4 160 which breached the HARD wall, six-box rule 5). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net.
